transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. AI. What brings you in today?

I've been struggling a lot with focusing, staying organized, and making careless mistakes lately. I wanted to get some help with these attention-related issues because it's becoming really frustrating.
Do you also often feel very restless, fidgety, interrupt others, or have trouble waiting your turn?
No, I don't really experience those things. My struggles are much more about focus, attention, and staying organized rather than physical restlessness or interrupting people.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Predominantly Inattentive Presentation), Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Combined Presentation)], but the patient explicitly denies hyperactive/impulsive symptoms such as restlessness, interrupting others, and difficulty waiting turn. That makes Combined Presentation unlikely, leaving Predominantly Inattentive Presentation as the current best candidate.
